_comment: Canonical iOS->server wire header manifest for POST /api/v2/apple/batch (Plan 2026-09-03). Additive over contracts/ios-headers.json — the v1 contract is frozen and this file adds one advisory header. Source of truth: datahub/contracts/v2-ios-headers.json. iOS mirrors this file at ios_app/Tests/HealthSyncTests/Fixtures/v2-ios-headers.json. Enforced by tests/contract/api_v2/test_v2_ios_headers.py (server consumes every header), the iOS V2HeaderContractTests (app emits exactly these), and tests/contract/test_ios_v2_headers_in_sync.py (byte-equal mirror). The body's schema_version=2 is the source of truth for the wire version; this header is advisory only — clients that don't send it still get v2 if their body declares schema_version=2.
